title: Musify v1.7.5.3.1 Update
changelog:
- Splash Screen Visual Polish: Restored transparent brand logo asset
- Critical Stability Fix: Resolved background recommendation crash caused by TimSort comparison contract violation across all Android versions
- Redesigned Favorites Screen: 3D glassmorphic glowing heart, ambient theme actions, dedicated filter chips, and animated equalizer wave highlights
- Redesigned Active Download Card: Floating theme-adaptive card with album artwork, real-time download speed, and clear queue stats
- Fixed Library Navigation: Direct root library screen restoration when switching between main tabs
- Personalized Home Greeting: Displays user's name dynamically from account details
